notes: Native construction creates no storage directory and performs no archive serialization.
Explicit in-memory archive creates no files and preserves result identity.
File, record, index and declared leaf catalogs are restored from bounded rkyv-framed metadata before search-ready.
Open reports the eager leaf-row catalog and zero lazy dictionary, sort, posting or leaf reads.
Eager open reports zero source reads and parses; source-free compaction reinforces the same boundary.
Exact file-path lookup and index-capability inspection succeed immediately after eager open without payload reads.
EXPLAIN remains successful after every selected lazy posting/FTS/sort/relation payload is corrupted.
An equality filter loads the field dictionary and one selected posting leaf; unrelated fields and sort/FTS payloads remain cold.
Presence and scalar-null queries use eager state masks with no lazy payload reads.
Selected FTS dictionaries and gram leaves load after reopen.
Missing gram returns empty without sibling leaf retention.
FTS loads gram leaves in cardinality order and skips the remaining gram after an empty intersection.
A selected title sort loads its key/order frames while the separately configured id column remains cold.
Repeated FTS query adds no index reads.
Empty leaves are canonical zero-length references; sparse, dense and alternating container shapes round-trip through the leaf codec.
Selected FTS and posting leaf requests admit only requested leaves; an equality filter retains exactly one posting leaf.
Zero-, one- and multi-record files retain path, membership and record associations after reopen.
Identical RecordIds remain scoped to their source collections before and after reopen.
Lossless non-UTF-8 path lookup is covered.
Snapshot-only indexed answers remain available while stale saved locators fail on materialization.
Stored posting dictionaries preserve dense key ordinals and resolve the selected leaf by that ordinal.
Inclusive scalar ranges round-trip with identical hits and counts.
Null, missing, empty-array and multi-value predicates match native state after reopen.
Large and sub-ULP decimal equality/ranges and descending sort retain exact values.
Tie, missing/null placement, both directions and an explicit composite order match native state.
Forward relations, exact target IDs, backlinks and related sorting match native results after lazy reopen.
Normal/skip grams, ASCII/Unicode folding and malformed raw fallback preserve hit identity after reopen.
An old view retains its store lease and performs a first lazy FTS load after root replacement.
Native lookup maps are released after archived ownership adoption, and retired owners are reclaimed when the last pinned view drops.
Posting bitmap, raw text, fallback and sort owner identities survive archive conversion without deep replacement.
Storage status reports zero compatibility row-cache bytes after eager open and normal metadata/index queries.
Cold payload packs remain untouched by a deletion-only resave.
Concurrent first access shares one posting dictionary read and one selected leaf read.
Different posting components load concurrently within a two-read permit.
A pre-cancelled cold query returns Cancelled without payload reads, and a later uncancelled query reuses the untouched backend successfully.
A transient missing dictionary error does not poison the cache and a later query succeeds after restoration.
Budgeted loads obey the resident target, oversize requests bypass retention, and Arc leases keep active query owners valid when trim/eviction removes cache keys.
An oversize selected payload serves the query, is not retained, and records the bypass.
Eager metadata remains resident while payload cache accounting stays at zero under a one-byte budget.
A retired native segment owner remains pinned only while an old view exists and is released after that view drops.
An old view retains its lease and lazy-loads after root replacement and Index drop.
Decoded leaf keys include the owning pack digest plus offset, preventing ordinal reuse across rebuilt components.
Seventy selected column frames leave at most 64 cached descriptors; active reads retain Arc handles across eviction.
Four barrier-started readers complete against the pinned root while a real mutated save publishes a new generation.
A completion callback re-enters unchanged save immediately after publication and observes no held transition or writer lock.
Native and memory-archive paths have no StoreSession or lazy disk resolver to enter.
Add after reopen publishes and persists the new records.
A one-record-per-segment JSONL replacement retires all old versions and preserves only new records across save/reopen.
Deleted files disappear from file catalog, filter, FTS and sorted queries while surviving sources remain searchable.
Deletion-only save leaves payload packs untouched.
Replacement and metadata-only move preserve identity/content, and move performs no additional lazy index-payload reads.
Cold full compaction succeeds with source files offline and preserves logical results.
Mixed native/cold compaction preserves pinned old, current and reopened views.
Four save/reopen checkpoints preserve reuse and semantic identity across mutation cycles.
No-change and deletion-only payload-reading limits are covered.
Exported cold FTS payloads reopen after the original store is moved offline.
A failed post-mutation save preserves CURRENT and leaves the three-record live RAM publication searchable.
Thirty-two cycles of add/update/move/delete with checkpoints every eight cycles match independent fresh builds.
Magic, version, flags, manifest length and checksum mutations are all rejected before publication.
Snapshot admission rejects liveness outside record domains and invalid collection, record-slot, membership and file routes.
Missing lazy payload does not affect eager open and fails when selected.
Stored dictionary key order and leaf descriptors are checked; archived tree/reverse-directory disagreement is rejected.
Stored leaf descriptors reject malformed ranges, zero cardinality, invalid offsets and absent digests before decode; checksum and trailing-byte checks execute on admission.
Sort frame loading rejects repeated slots, out-of-domain slots and coverage mismatches.
Registered reader version changes fail open, and schema/indexing fingerprint changes are rejected separately.
Named faults at object write/file sync/install and CURRENT write/file sync/rename all leave the previous CURRENT unchanged.
An injected rename failure preserves the previous CURRENT byte-for-byte.
Post-rename directory sync failure is classified as CommitUncertain with generation and manifest identity.
A child process aborts at the post-rename sync barrier; reopening yields either the complete old or complete new generation.
The transaction trace orders dependency sync/install before CURRENT sync/rename and final store-directory sync.
A second unrelated writer is rejected.
A barrier-started opener resolves to either the complete old or new snapshot and never a mixed generation; the final reopen resolves to the new one.
An empty completed publication saves, reopens and queries as an empty index.
Zero limits and undersized manifest admission fail explicitly without publishing an open snapshot; bounded leaf/frame limits are tested separately.
A mismatched source root is rejected instead of becoming an empty index.
Audit detects unused payload corruption while ordinary open remains lazy.
Prune is blocked by a shared reader lease.
Prune preserves current dependencies and unrelated files while removing owned orphans and staging files.
Prune returns an error before deleting an unrelated orphan when CURRENT metadata is corrupt.
Workspace CLI/TUI/desktop compile, and ordinary CLI startup leaves the index/cache directory absent.
